"""Acceptance checks for the cost-aware model router."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from router.cost_aware import (
    FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
    MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
    route,
)


class CostAwareRouterTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.log_path = Path(self.id().replace(".", "_") + "-laya.jsonl")
        if self.log_path.exists():
            self.log_path.unlink()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        if self.log_path.exists():
            self.log_path.unlink()

    def _record(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        lines = self.log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip().splitlines()
        self.assertEqual(len(lines), 1)
        return json.loads(lines[0])

    def test_morning_brief_is_instant_action_under_min_budget(self) -> None:
        decision = route("Bring up the morning brief", log_path=self.log_path)

        self.assertEqual(decision.tier, "instant_action")
        self.assertEqual(decision.selected, "morning_brief")
        self.assertLess(decision.estimated_cost, MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD)
        self.assertEqual(decision.budget_criterion, "under_min_budget_threshold")
        self.assertIn("Morning brief — 2026-09-29", decision.output)
        self.assertIn("Calendar:", decision.output)
        record = self._record()
        self.assertEqual(record["consumer"], "laya_shadow_training")
        self.assertEqual(record["tier"], "instant_action")
        self.assertTrue(decision.logged_for_laya)

    def test_biggest_news_uses_fast_model_budget(self) -> None:
        decision = route("What was the biggest news?", log_path=self.log_path)

        self.assertEqual(decision.tier, "fast_model")
        self.assertEqual(decision.selected, "cheap_fast_model")
        self.assertGreaterEqual(decision.estimated_cost, MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD)
        self.assertLessEqual(decision.estimated_cost, FAST_MODEL_BUDGET)
        self.assertEqual(decision.budget_criterion, "within_fast_model_budget")
        self.assertTrue(decision.output.startswith("The biggest news"))
        self.assertLess(len(decision.output.splitlines()), 3)
        record = self._record()
        self.assertEqual(record["tier"], "fast_model")
        self.assertEqual(record["budget_criterion"], "within_fast_model_budget")

    def test_explainer_escalates_to_full_agent_and_logs_for_laya(self) -> None:
        decision = route("Write me an explainer", log_path=self.log_path)

        self.assertEqual(decision.tier, "full_agent")
        self.assertEqual(decision.selected, "full_agent")
        self.assertGreater(decision.estimated_cost, FAST_MODEL_BUDGET)
        self.assertEqual(decision.budget_criterion, "exceeds_fast_model_budget")
        self.assertIn("composition_request", decision.escalation_criteria)
        self.assertIn("longform_artifact", decision.escalation_criteria)
        self.assertIn("exceeds_fast_model_budget", decision.escalation_criteria)
        self.assertEqual(decision.output, "Assigned to full agent: Write me an explainer")

        record = self._record()
        self.assertEqual(record["consumer"], "laya_shadow_training")
        self.assertEqual(record["purpose"], "shadow_training")
        self.assertEqual(record["request"], "Write me an explainer")
        self.assertEqual(record["tier"], "full_agent")
        self.assertIn("composition_request", record["escalation_criteria"])
        self.assertTrue(decision.logged_for_laya)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Cost-aware router.

A request is an instant action, a fast model call, or a full agent.
Budget units are an internal routing currency, not dollars.

Thresholds
- MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD: estimated cost below this never calls a model.
- FAST_MODEL_BUDGET: generative requests at or under this ceiling use the cheap model.
- Above that ceiling, escalation criteria send the request to a full agent.

Every decision is appended to the Laya shadow-training log.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD = 1.0
FAST_MODEL_BUDGET = 5.0

INSTANT_ACTION_COST = 0.25
FAST_MODEL_COST = 1.5
FULL_AGENT_COST = 20.0

CATALOG_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "catalog"
DEFAULT_LAYA_LOG = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "logs" / "laya-shadow-training.jsonl"
)

# Exact normalized phrases. A simple lookup has to name a catalog action,
# not merely share a word with one.
INSTANT_ACTIONS: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {
    "morning_brief": {
        "phrases": (
            "bring up the morning brief",
            "show the morning brief",
            "pull up the morning brief",
        ),
        "file": "morning_brief.txt",
    }
}

ESCALATION_RULES: tuple[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]], ...] = (
    ("composition_request", re.compile(r"\b(write|draft|compose|author)\b", re.I)),
    (
        "longform_artifact",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(explainer|essay|tutorial|deep[- ]dive|specification|postmortem)\b",
            re.I,
        ),
    ),
)

GENERATIVE_STARTS = ("what ", "who ", "why ", "how ", "when ", "where ", "which ")


@dataclass
class Decision:
    request: str
    tier: str
    estimated_cost: float
    min_budget_threshold: float
    fast_model_budget: float
    budget_criterion: str
    selected: str
    output: str
    escalation_criteria: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    logged_for_laya: bool = False

    def to_record(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        record = asdict(self)
        record["consumer"] = "laya_shadow_training"
        record["purpose"] = "shadow_training"
        record["timestamp"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        return record


def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    collapsed = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text.strip().lower())
    return collapsed.replace("?", "").replace("!", "").replace(".", "")


def match_instant_action(request: str) -> str | None:
    norm = normalize(request)
    for action_id, spec in INSTANT_ACTIONS.items():
        phrases = spec["phrases"]
        assert isinstance(phrases, tuple)
        for phrase in phrases:
            if norm == phrase or norm == f"please {phrase}":
                return action_id
    return None


def escalation_criteria(request: str) -> list[str]:
    hits = [name for name, pattern in ESCALATION_RULES if pattern.search(request)]
    if hits:
        hits.append("exceeds_fast_model_budget")
    return hits


def is_fast_generative(request: str) -> bool:
    raw = request.strip()
    norm = normalize(request)
    if raw.endswith("?"):
        return True
    return norm.startswith(GENERATIVE_STARTS)


def budget_criterion_for(cost: float) -> str:
    if cost < MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD:
        return "under_min_budget_threshold"
    if cost <= FAST_MODEL_BUDGET:
        return "within_fast_model_budget"
    return "exceeds_fast_model_budget"


def execute_instant(action_id: str) -> str:
    spec = INSTANT_ACTIONS[action_id]
    filename = spec["file"]
    assert isinstance(filename, str)
    return (CATALOG_DIR / filename).read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()


def execute_fast_model(request: str) -> str:
    """Bounded extractive answer. One line, no elaboration, so the call stays cheap."""
    del request  # the snapshot is the cheap model's only context window
    snapshot = (CATALOG_DIR / "news_snapshot.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return snapshot.splitlines()[0]


def execute_full_agent(request: str) -> str:
    return f"Assigned to full agent: {request}"


def log_for_laya(decision: Decision, log_path: Path) -> None:
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(decision.to_record(), sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    decision.logged_for_laya = True


def route(request: str, log_path: Path | None = DEFAULT_LAYA_LOG) -> Decision:
    """Pick the cheapest tier that satisfies the request, then log the choice."""
    criteria = escalation_criteria(request)
    if criteria:
        decision = Decision(
            request=request,
            tier="full_agent",
            estimated_cost=FULL_AGENT_COST,
            min_budget_threshold=MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
            fast_model_budget=FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
            budget_criterion=budget_criterion_for(FULL_AGENT_COST),
            selected="full_agent",
            output=execute_full_agent(request),
            escalation_criteria=criteria,
        )
    else:
        action_id = match_instant_action(request)
        if action_id is not None and INSTANT_ACTION_COST < MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD:
            decision = Decision(
                request=request,
                tier="instant_action",
                estimated_cost=INSTANT_ACTION_COST,
                min_budget_threshold=MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
                fast_model_budget=FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
                budget_criterion=budget_criterion_for(INSTANT_ACTION_COST),
                selected=action_id,
                output=execute_instant(action_id),
            )
        elif is_fast_generative(request) and FAST_MODEL_COST <= FAST_MODEL_BUDGET:
            decision = Decision(
                request=request,
                tier="fast_model",
                estimated_cost=FAST_MODEL_COST,
                min_budget_threshold=MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
                fast_model_budget=FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
                budget_criterion=budget_criterion_for(FAST_MODEL_COST),
                selected="cheap_fast_model",
                output=execute_fast_model(request),
            )
        else:
            fallback_criteria = ["unclassified_request", "exceeds_fast_model_budget"]
            decision = Decision(
                request=request,
                tier="full_agent",
                estimated_cost=FULL_AGENT_COST,
                min_budget_threshold=MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
                fast_model_budget=FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
                budget_criterion=budget_criterion_for(FULL_AGENT_COST),
                selected="full_agent",
                output=execute_full_agent(request),
                escalation_criteria=fallback_criteria,
            )

    if log_path is not None:
        log_for_laya(decision, log_path)
    return decision


def main() -> None:
    samples = (
        "Bring up the morning brief",
        "What was the biggest news?",
        "Write me an explainer",
    )
    for request in samples:
        decision = route(request)
        print(json.dumps(decision.to_record(), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Cost-aware router.

A request is an instant action, a fast model call, or a full agent.
Budget units are an internal routing currency, not dollars.

Thresholds
- MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD: estimated cost below this never calls a model.
- FAST_MODEL_BUDGET: generative requests at or under this ceiling use the cheap model.
- Above that ceiling, escalation criteria send the request to a full agent.

Every decision is appended to the Laya shadow-training log.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD = 1.0
FAST_MODEL_BUDGET = 5.0

INSTANT_ACTION_COST = 0.25
FAST_MODEL_COST = 1.5
FULL_AGENT_COST = 20.0

CATALOG_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "catalog"
DEFAULT_LAYA_LOG = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "logs" / "laya-shadow-training.jsonl"
)

# Exact normalized phrases. A simple lookup has to name a catalog action,
# not merely share a word with one.
INSTANT_ACTIONS: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {
    "morning_brief": {
        "phrases": (
            "bring up the morning brief",
            "show the morning brief",
            "pull up the morning brief",
        ),
        "file": "morning_brief.txt",
    }
}

ESCALATION_RULES: tuple[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]], ...] = (
    ("composition_request", re.compile(r"\b(write|draft|compose|author)\b", re.I)),
    (
        "longform_artifact",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(explainer|essay|tutorial|deep[- ]dive|specification|postmortem)\b",
            re.I,
        ),
    ),
)

GENERATIVE_STARTS = ("what ", "who ", "why ", "how ", "when ", "where ", "which ")


@dataclass
class Decision:
    request: str
    tier: str
    estimated_cost: float
    min_budget_threshold: float
    fast_model_budget: float
    budget_criterion: str
    selected: str
    output: str
    escalation_criteria: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    logged_for_laya: bool = False

    def to_record(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        record = asdict(self)
        record["consumer"] = "laya_shadow_training"
        record["purpose"] = "shadow_training"
        record["timestamp"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        return record


def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    collapsed = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text.strip().lower())
    return collapsed.replace("?", "").replace("!", "").replace(".", "")


def match_instant_action(request: str) -> str | None:
    norm = normalize(request)
    for action_id, spec in INSTANT_ACTIONS.items():
        phrases = spec["phrases"]
        assert isinstance(phrases, tuple)
        for phrase in phrases:
            if norm == phrase or norm == f"please {phrase}":
                return action_id
    return None


def escalation_criteria(request: str) -> list[str]:
    hits = [name for name, pattern in ESCALATION_RULES if pattern.search(request)]
    if hits:
        hits.append("exceeds_fast_model_budget")
    return hits


def is_fast_generative(request: str) -> bool:
    raw = request.strip()
    norm = normalize(request)
    if raw.endswith("?"):
        return True
    return norm.startswith(GENERATIVE_STARTS)


def budget_criterion_for(cost: float) -> str:
    if cost < MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD:
        return "under_min_budget_threshold"
    if cost <= FAST_MODEL_BUDGET:
        return "within_fast_model_budget"
    return "exceeds_fast_model_budget"


def execute_instant(action_id: str) -> str:
    spec = INSTANT_ACTIONS[action_id]
    filename = spec["file"]
    assert isinstance(filename, str)
    return (CATALOG_DIR / filename).read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()


def execute_fast_model(request: str) -> str:
    """Bounded extractive answer. One line, no elaboration, so the call stays cheap."""
    del request  # the snapshot is the cheap model's only context window
    snapshot = (CATALOG_DIR / "news_snapshot.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return snapshot.splitlines()[0]


def execute_full_agent(request: str) -> str:
    return f"Assigned to full agent: {request}"


def log_for_laya(decision: Decision, log_path: Path) -> None:
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(decision.to_record(), sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    decision.logged_for_laya = True


def route(request: str, log_path: Path | None = DEFAULT_LAYA_LOG) -> Decision:
    """Pick the cheapest tier that satisfies the request, then log the choice."""
    criteria = escalation_criteria(request)
    if criteria:
        decision = Decision(
            request=request,
            tier="full_agent",
            estimated_cost=FULL_AGENT_COST,
            min_budget_threshold=MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
            fast_model_budget=FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
            budget_criterion=budget_criterion_for(FULL_AGENT_COST),
            selected="full_agent",
            output=execute_full_agent(request),
            escalation_criteria=criteria,
        )
    else:
        action_id = match_instant_action(request)
        if action_id is not None and INSTANT_ACTION_COST < MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD:
            decision = Decision(
                request=request,
                tier="instant_action",
                estimated_cost=INSTANT_ACTION_COST,
                min_budget_threshold=MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
                fast_model_budget=FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
                budget_criterion=budget_criterion_for(INSTANT_ACTION_COST),
                selected=action_id,
                output=execute_instant(action_id),
            )
        elif is_fast_generative(request) and FAST_MODEL_COST <= FAST_MODEL_BUDGET:
            decision = Decision(
                request=request,
                tier="fast_model",
                estimated_cost=FAST_MODEL_COST,
                min_budget_threshold=MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
                fast_model_budget=FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
                budget_criterion=budget_criterion_for(FAST_MODEL_COST),
                selected="cheap_fast_model",
                output=execute_fast_model(request),
            )
        else:
            fallback_criteria = ["unclassified_request", "exceeds_fast_model_budget"]
            decision = Decision(
                request=request,
                tier="full_agent",
                estimated_cost=FULL_AGENT_COST,
                min_budget_threshold=MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
                fast_model_budget=FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
                budget_criterion=budget_criterion_for(FULL_AGENT_COST),
                selected="full_agent",
                output=execute_full_agent(request),
                escalation_criteria=fallback_criteria,
            )

    if log_path is not None:
        log_for_laya(decision, log_path)
    return decision


def main() -> None:
    samples = (
        "Bring up the morning brief",
        "What was the biggest news?",
        "Write me an explainer",
    )
    for request in samples:
        decision = route(request)
        print(json.dumps(decision.to_record(), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from router.cost_aware import (
    FAST_MODEL_BUDGET,
    MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD,
    route,
)


class CostAwareRouterTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.log_path = Path(self.id().replace(".", "_") + "-laya.jsonl")
        if self.log_path.exists():
            self.log_path.unlink()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        if self.log_path.exists():
            self.log_path.unlink()

    def _record(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        lines = self.log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip().splitlines()
        self.assertEqual(len(lines), 1)
        return json.loads(lines[0])

    def test_morning_brief_is_instant_action_under_min_budget(self) -> None:
        decision = route("Bring up the morning brief", log_path=self.log_path)

        self.assertEqual(decision.tier, "instant_action")
        self.assertEqual(decision.selected, "morning_brief")
        self.assertLess(decision.estimated_cost, MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD)
        self.assertEqual(decision.budget_criterion, "under_min_budget_threshold")
        self.assertIn("Morning brief — 2026-09-29", decision.output)
        self.assertIn("Calendar:", decision.output)
        record = self._record()
        self.assertEqual(record["consumer"], "laya_shadow_training")
        self.assertEqual(record["tier"], "instant_action")
        self.assertTrue(decision.logged_for_laya)

    def test_biggest_news_uses_fast_model_budget(self) -> None:
        decision = route("What was the biggest news?", log_path=self.log_path)

        self.assertEqual(decision.tier, "fast_model")
        self.assertEqual(decision.selected, "cheap_fast_model")
        self.assertGreaterEqual(decision.estimated_cost, MIN_BUDGET_THRESHOLD)
        self.assertLessEqual(decision.estimated_cost, FAST_MODEL_BUDGET)
        self.assertEqual(decision.budget_criterion, "within_fast_model_budget")
        self.assertTrue(decision.output.startswith("The biggest news"))
        self.assertLess(len(decision.output.splitlines()), 3)
        record = self._record()
        self.assertEqual(record["tier"], "fast_model")
        self.assertEqual(record["budget_criterion"], "within_fast_model_budget")

    def test_explainer_escalates_to_full_agent_and_logs_for_laya(self) -> None:
        decision = route("Write me an explainer", log_path=self.log_path)

        self.assertEqual(decision.tier, "full_agent")
        self.assertEqual(decision.selected, "full_agent")
        self.assertGreater(decision.estimated_cost, FAST_MODEL_BUDGET)
        self.assertEqual(decision.budget_criterion, "exceeds_fast_model_budget")
        self.assertIn("composition_request", decision.escalation_criteria)
        self.assertIn("longform_artifact", decision.escalation_criteria)
        self.assertIn("exceeds_fast_model_budget", decision.escalation_criteria)
        self.assertEqual(decision.output, "Assigned to full agent: Write me an explainer")

        record = self._record()
        self.assertEqual(record["consumer"], "laya_shadow_training")
        self.assertEqual(record["purpose"], "shadow_training")
        self.assertEqual(record["request"], "Write me an explainer")
        self.assertEqual(record["tier"], "full_agent")
        self.assertIn("composition_request", record["escalation_criteria"])
        self.assertTrue(decision.logged_for_laya)

    unittest.main()
